method: Sequential real-time 30-second runs after 2-second warmup; no forced draws or manual simulation steps. Native sheets and packed sheets use identical grass/commands/114-person starting force. Actual dt differs normally; this is not a deterministic frame replay.
limits: One run per mode; not a long-duration performance acceptance
No isolated GPU timer, resource-load timing or end-to-end input latency measurement
Engine texture allocation monitor is not total OS GPU memory
